notes.text: The letter is addressed to Verdier and dated Massy le 18.5.1971. This sheet has two body paragraphs, ends in a question, and has no closing or signature. The lower-left pencilled 14 is an archive sheet number.
notes.basis: Observation: date, salutation, final line and bottom-left corner.

notes.text: The writer says Saavedra helped make an index for Chap IV, par.9 à 13, and asks for the two Deligne appendices to be sent for typing. Their titles are described as assez, de points and image inverse d'un plat; the comma after assez is retained.
notes.basis: Observation: paragraph 1 lines 1–7; no external identification of the appendices.

notes.text: The writer asks for a corrected exercise 4.10.6 (médaille chocolat), says he has forgotten what was canulé, and asks for something true to replace the false material. Neither the exercise statement nor a proposed replacement appears here. No mathematical proof checking was performed in this reader run.
notes.basis: Observation: paragraph 1 lines 8–13. Transcription only; check_events is empty.

notes.text: The writer requests instructions about completing SGA 4, prefers leaving it incomplet et dégueulasse to spending one or two days away from boulot survie, and asks whether Artin wants his packet of errata, footnotes and improvements concerning exposés after VI.
notes.basis: Observation: paragraph 2; no inference about later action or completion.

notes.text: The clipped words pour and entièrement remain candidate readings, not recovered letters. In the two superpositions, the component glyphs are clearer than their chronology: o/l and e/apostrophe. Context was not used to impose a final correction order.
